text: Snap hooks on at least two opposite walls keep the lid shut, with undercut engagement of 0.4 mm or more and flex within a 2 percent strain limit; the lid must come off by hand. A hook arm is 1.2 to 2.0 mm thick, 9.0 mm or more in free length and 5.0 mm or more wide, undercut not above 1.0 mm, retention face 45 to 65 degrees and lead-in face 20 to 40 degrees from horizontal, and each hook has to remain engaged when the lid is raised 0.3 mm.
